description: Réseau de transport en commun LiA (GTFS, Siri) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Réseau de transport en commun Le Havre Seine Métropole LiA. List of stops, times and routes of the public transport network LiA of the Urban Community Le Havre Seine Métropole. Dataset in GTFS and Siri format. SIRI documentation:&x20; The functions of the API are: SIRI query RequeteCheckStatus SIRI query LinesDiscovery SIRI StopPoint Discovery request. Coverage: Réseau de transport en commun Le Havre Seine Métropole LiA. The portal shows the English title as "LiA Public Transit System (GTFS, Siri)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Réseau de transport en commun Le Havre Seine Métropole LiA. Its keywords include ler, funiculaire, bus, bus-et-tramway, lia, gtfs. The listing shows 6 download or service links in GTFS-RT, SIRI, HTML, GTFS. The listing shows 2026-05-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
